entries.title: Parc publique du Bois-de-Coulonge, Quebec ville, Canada.jpg
entries.description: Bois-de-Coulonge public park, Quebec city, Canada. Quebec's Government House, known as Spencer Wood, was the viceregal residence of Quebec. It was built in 1854. Located at Bois-de-Coulonge Park (upstream of the Plains of Abraham and overlooking Anse-au-Foulon) in Sillery, it was purchased by the Quebec government in 1870, and served as the residence of Quebec lieutenant governors until 1966, when a major fire destroyed the main residence.
entries.creator: Wilfredor
